verified_data.evidence_line: Payroll held in name R. Okoye, address matches claim.

case_notes.note: Neighbour says R. Okoye lives here. Possible long-running concealment, third time this has come up.

deciding.undeclared_change: Trusted feed payroll_monthly 1450 against declared 600 crosses band_upper_earnings 1000, and no change_notified entry exists.
deciding.next_step: No draft_rate and no outstanding request; the earnings gap supports revising, but the unlisted R. Okoye in the note leaves a hold to confirm household membership defensible.
deciding.change_category: The earnings gap points to income, but the payroll is in the name of R. Okoye, who is absent from the members list (tenancy_occupants 1), which equally suggests a household change.
deciding.affected_scope: Only the single claimant award is involved; the household has 1 member and no linked claims appear.
deciding.affected_duration: effective_from 2024-12-09 to 2025-06-09 is exactly 182 days, the edge between 4-26 weeks and over 26 weeks.
